data.body:
**[P2] Make shared-tracer wrapper installation atomic**

Concurrent factory calls can construct plugins against the same cached tracer. Their constructors perform unsynchronized check-then-set installation of `DeterministicIdGenerator` and `DurableSampler`; both can wrap the original value, after which the losing plugin retains a generator the tracer no longer uses. Its deterministic overrides are then ignored and durable span IDs become random, breaking stitching. Serialize installation per tracer and return the installed winner, covering both factory classes with a barrier-based shared-tracer test.
